fix(auth): retain login admission until cancellation settles
fix(auth): preserve account pins and reject ambiguous login owners
fix(auth): preserve protocol ordering and optional login metadata
test(auth): narrow optional login button actions
fix(auth): revalidate chat login authority at persistent effects
test(telegram): use the session writer contract in login proof
fix(models): publish hosted login through the shared auth owner
test(auth): use a neutral recovery fixture model
fix(models): settle sign-in when its view closes
fix(auth): reconcile provider login refresh outcomes
